description:
AUTO_INCREMENT Exhaustion — SCH0004

Flags tables whose AUTO_INCREMENT counter has reached a share (default 95 %) of the capacity of the integer column type holding it (TINYINT 127/255, SMALLINT 32767/65535, MEDIUMINT 8388607/16777215, INT 2147483647/4294967295, BIGINT 2^63-1 / 2^64-1). When the counter reaches the maximum every INSERT fails with "Duplicate entry ... for key 'PRIMARY'". The value read is information_schema.TABLES.AUTO_INCREMENT, the next value to be handed out (the schema scan reads it with fresh statistics on every flavor). All tables past the threshold are reported in a single SCH0004 finding per run, sorted by ratio, with the widening ALTER TABLE as remediation (UNSIGNED when the column is signed, then BIGINT UNSIGNED). Wire v4 (auto_increment and column extra on the schema snapshot).

prerequisites.description: Schema column metadata must be monitored (monitoring-schema-columns=true) — the AUTO_INCREMENT column and its type come from it; without it this check reports nothing

config_keys.label: Capacity threshold (%)
config_keys.help: Report a table when its next AUTO_INCREMENT value is at or past this share of the column type's maximum.

config_keys.label: Mask schema/table/column names
config_keys.help: Partially obscure schema, table and column names in the finding (e.g. "window" -> "wi???ow") and drop the ALTER TABLE statements, so the log entry is not directly useful to someone who only has log access (PCI-DSS style deployments).
